SC1.reason: Agree with Approach B (`mori_core::stage::sequence::Sequence`) over Approach A (`start_successor` with an externally supplied `CompletePrefix`). In the current stage API, `StageOutcome::Complete` retains only the final `StageSegment`, so a bare `Complete` loses earlier `Waiting` segments, prior attempted work, and unselected global frame state. Approach A would immediately require inventing and validating an external full-prefix carrier across calls (forcing premature resolution of persistent reopen/identity rules under OD2/OD7) while still needing the same internal projection, lifting, and accounting logic. Approach B directly closes the boundary gap in-process by owning the global `Snapshot` head, active continuation, and complete call/effect prefixes, ensuring `Sequence::next` transitions strictly from the actual completed predecessor head without accepting caller-supplied successor state or prior accounting.

SC2.reason: Agree with explicit whole-frame projection and lossless outside-frame lifting over a complete global `Snapshot`. Constructing the successor `Scenario` inside `Sequence` by projecting mapped states, all balance rows for declared exact `AssetId`s (including observer accounts), and mapped present duties—while holding the complement `outside` frame `F` invariant across the call and lifting every `Step.snapshot` and post-boundary via the inverse binding map—cleanly supports heterogeneous program schemas and shared serial assets without mutating `stage::start`, `stage::resume`, or `runtime::scenario_snapshot`. Admission of alias topologies and incoming discharge-only or awaiting duty boundaries (including R7 `decode::canonical_boundary` constraints) remains properly gated on OD1.

SC3.reason: Agree with retaining every original `OutcomeReport` once in `root.calls` and linking global observations and effects via run-local prefix lengths (`call_prefix_len`, `effect_prefix_len`). Preserving `whole_pre`, `whole_post`, `projected_pre`, `projected_post`, `outside`, `framed_steps`, and exact `EffectLink` indices guarantees that both local stage semantics (including multi-await progressions and `Waiting(advanced: false)` false-guard observations) and their lifted global images remain inspectable without rewriting nested stage labels or truncating zero/self/repeated effects.

SC4.reason: Agree with exposing one production composition path (`mori_core::stage::sequence::Sequence` and `mori compose`) and reusing the same plan loader and driver in `commands/test/sequence_test.rs` under profile `moriarty-tests/sequential-proposed/1`. This prevents test-only evaluators or expected-output fixtures from supplying successor state, continuations, or prior accounting, and preserves the preloaded-expectation discipline established in `disjoint_test.rs`.

SC5.reason: Agree with the complete ordinary financial and logical accounting specification. Tracking per-`(AssetId, account)` opening/closing balances, transfer/fee volumes, gross debits/credits, and signed-direction net changes alongside statement-distinguished liability additions, discharges, presence (preserving present-zero rows), and full global residuals captures the exact local scalar evolution without cross-asset aggregation or silent netting. Likewise, summing `attempted` per call while summing only the latest `committed` prefix per started action instance avoids double-counting cumulative continuation prefixes across awaits, and keeping `remaining_closure_reserve` distinct from `available_ordinary` on normal traces is sound while deferring global enforcement, failure charges, and reserve authority to OD4.

SC6.reason: Agree with retaining full scope separation across all 35 MPLR behavioral clauses (`MPLR-001` through `MPLR-035`), the five composition operators (sequential, disjoint parallel `Pair`, shared-state interleaving `SI1–SI4`, atomic `Join`, and asynchronous messaging), existing Core/1 and Core/2 behavior, and all designated-owner contracts (`OD1`–`OD8`). Local in-process `Sequence` completion is strictly local control progress (`Qualification: local-reference-stage`, `Authentication: none`, `Consumption: untracked`) and does not substitute for native ZKIRv3 correspondence, authenticated continuations, obligation consent, or external settlement finality.

summaryVerbatim: Recommend Approach B (`recommend-B-conditional`) with `agree` on SC1–SC6, strictly conditioned on designated-owner contracts OD1–OD8 and independent expectation derivation (`CSQ-015`) prior to implementation integration. Owning the global `Snapshot` head, outside frame, active continuation, and complete call/effect prefixes inside `mori_core::stage::sequence::Sequence` cleanly supports completed-predecessor-to-successor execution (`P -> Q`) over existing `stage::load`, `stage::start`, `stage::resume`, and `stage::outcome_report` without trusting caller-supplied successor state or prematurely inventing an unauthenticated external `CompletePrefix` reopen carrier (Approach A). Minor design refinements are noted for per-invocation binding injectivity, R7 (`canonical_boundary`) interactions with incoming duties on awaiting actions under OD1, and explicit wire definitions for expanded `PrefixObservation` test fixtures.

allFindingsVerbatim.issue: Normal-path inverse lifting in `DESIGN.md` (Rule 5) and `WIRE-CONTRACT.md` (`FramedStep.whole_snapshot` and `EffectLink.whole_effect`) requires `FrameBindings.states` and `FrameBindings.duties` to be injective within each single invocation (no two local state keys or local duty names of the same invocation mapping to the same global key) and requires `FrameBindings.duties` to cover every local liability name created by `Statement::Liability` in that invocation. While cross-invocation aliasing is intended and alias admission is routed to OD1, per-invocation injectivity is a mathematical prerequisite for the normal-path inverse map itself.
allFindingsVerbatim.nextStep: State per-invocation injectivity of `state_bindings` and `duty_bindings` (and complete coverage of local source liabilities) explicitly as a baseline normal-path precondition in `DESIGN.md` and `OD1`.

evidence.quote: if let Some(identity) = identities.get(l.name.as_str()) && *identity != (&l.asset, l.debtor.as_str(), l.creditor.as_str())
evidence.supports: `runtime::scenario_snapshot` only checks identity equality when the local program itself declares a `Statement::Liability` for that name.
`decode::canonical_boundary` (invoked by `stage::start` when `!plan.sites.is_empty()` and by `stage::resume` at R7) rejects any incoming liability absent from the local program's liability registry.

allFindingsVerbatim.issue: Because `stage::start` invokes `decode::canonical_boundary` whenever `!plan.sites.is_empty()` (H25) and `stage::resume` invokes it at R7, an awaiting successor action cannot accept a projected incoming liability unless that liability is registered in `decode::registry(p)`, whereas a non-awaiting action only passes through `runtime::scenario_snapshot`. Under unchanged stage admission, discharge-only incoming duties on awaiting actions will be refused by `canonical_boundary` unless `OD1` defines how duty registry identities are admitted or restricted.
allFindingsVerbatim.nextStep: Ensure the `OD1` owner contract explicitly specifies the supported domain for incoming projected duties across non-awaiting versus awaiting actions under R7/`canonical_boundary`.
